prior_P2: Ranks 42..49 passed the frozen sufficient-certificate protocol. P3 changes no rule and doubles the replication batch to 16 records.

holdout_selection.selection_rule: next sixteen canonical records immediately after P2

frozen_certificate_protocol.target: Require exact D(s)>0 and exact N'_{j+1}(s)>0 on the closed source segment.
frozen_certificate_protocol.non_target: Certify every KKT numerator except basic_p_{j+1} strictly positive on the entire closed source segment, first by exact interval enclosure and then by the existing exact adaptive positivity certifier if required.
frozen_certificate_protocol.classification: Use only the frozen lower-endpoint sign of N_{j+1} together with the sufficient certificates. Negative lower sign predicts one unique left basic_p_{j+1} boundary; positive lower sign predicts full coverage.
frozen_certificate_protocol.full_atlas_after_certificate: Only after certificate classification is fixed, run the existing exact atlas and direct-matrix checkpoint regression.

pass: All 16 records obtain a complete sufficient certificate; certificate classes equal frozen parent predictions and exact atlas classes; every partial boundary is exactly left basic_p_{j+1}; direct exact regressions have zero mismatches and zero positivity/outside-sign failures.
refute: Any exact non-target nonpositive witness, class mismatch, boundary mismatch, or symbolic/direct exact mismatch refutes P3 support.
inconclusive: Any unresolved exact certificate or execution failure without a mathematical counterexample is inconclusive.
no_posthoc_changes: No rank replacement, batch resizing, condition substitution, support changes, tolerance changes, or rescue classifier after outcomes are inspected.
nonclaims: not beyond the A102 gamma-plus architecture/source segments
